summary: Onar Holding Corp filed an 8-K disclosing Amendment No. 1 to a Letter of Intent to acquire all equity of Advertise Purple, Inc. The amendment confirms a $1,000,000 down payment toward the purchase price, refundable only if Onar delivers a closing readiness notice and Advertise Purple or sellers fail to sign the fully negotiated purchase agreement and close within five business days. The purchase agreement is attached but unexecuted. This is a non-binding LOI with a negotiated form, creating risk that the transaction may not close; the non-refundable down payment except in narrow circumstances raises the stakes. Watch for execution of the purchase agreement and closing timing.
